verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs describe a statistics engine behind experiments: it reports metric lifts with confidence intervals, offers CUPED and Stratified Sampling for variance reduction, and runs power analysis. However, the evidence never documents the engine's methodology, such as whether it is frequentist or Bayesian, or how tests and corrections work. CUPED is also cited only from the Warehouse Native introduction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the frequentist/Bayesian methodology, confirmation that variance reduction (CUPED) is available in Statsig Cloud as well as Warehouse Native, independent hands-on validation of the stats engine's rigor.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
